candidate.title: Delta lists BC Day holiday hours for Monday, Aug. 3

evidence.readerImpact: Delta residents can check City Hall, Municipal Services Office, animal shelter, seniors centre, discovery centre, and recreation-facility holiday hours before making an Aug. 3 trip.
evidence.freshnessEvidence: The official City of Delta page is dated July 28, 2026 and covers the upcoming Monday, Aug. 3, 2026 BC Day holiday.
evidence.uniqueAngleEvidence: Repository and source-queue checks found no published Trends Today article about Delta's 2026 BC Day municipal holiday hours.
factualSupport: The City of Delta notice lists BC Day as Monday, Aug. 3, 2026.
The notice lists City Hall, the Municipal Services Office, Delta Community Animal Shelter, McKee Seniors Recreation Centre, and Kennedy Seniors Recreation Centre as closed for BC Day.
The notice says Douglas J. Husband Discovery Centre is open noon to 5 p.m.
The notice says North Delta Recreation Centre and all other Parks, Recreation & Culture recreation facilities have regular operating hours, except named closures.
The notice gives 604-940-7111, press 1, for animal emergencies.
